# New Enterprise Forum

> Michigan's premier startup ecosystem hub connecting entrepreneurs with coaching, pitch competitions, and investor networks.

The New Enterprise Forum (NEF) is a Michigan-based nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting early-stage startups through mentorship, competitive pitch events, and investor relations. Based in the Ann Arbor/Ypsilanti region, NEF serves as a central resource for entrepreneurs seeking guidance, funding opportunities, and community connections.

## Key Topics

- Startup Coaching
- Pitch Competitions
- Investor Networking
- Membership Benefits
- Michigan Startups
- Entrepreneurship
- Venture Capital
- Pitch Pit
- SIRA Assessment
- Founder Mentorship

- Inclusive Leadership

## Core Programs & Competitions

- [Pitch Pit Competitions](https://newenterpriseforum.org/entrepreneurs/pitch-pit-competitions): Pitch Pit Competitions and SIRA startup investment readiness assessment program
- [Get Coached](https://newenterpriseforum.org/entrepreneurs/get-coached): Startup coaching application process and pitch preparation guide for entrepreneurs
- [Startup Coaching](https://newenterpriseforum.org/get-coached): Startup coaching application and investor pitch preparation process
- [Become a Coach](https://newenterpriseforum.org/become-a-coach): Coaching program recruitment for entrepreneur mentors and pitch training volunteers

## Membership & Community

- [Become A Member](https://newenterpriseforum.org/membership/become-a-member): NEF membership pricing, benefits, and application for Michigan entrepreneurs
- [Membership Signup](https://newenterpriseforum.org/become-a-member): NEF membership signup with pricing and community benefits for Michigan startups
- [Member Login](https://newenterpriseforum.org/membership/member-login): Member portal authentication and profile management via Wild Apricot
- [Sponsors & Partners](https://newenterpriseforum.org/sponsors): NEF sponsorship levels, partner directory, and membership benefits

## Investor Relations & Deal Flow

- [Investors](https://newenterpriseforum.org/investors): Investor relations, deal flow, and angel investor membership opportunities

## Entrepreneur Resources

- [Entrepreneur Tool Kit](https://newenterpriseforum.org/entrepreneurs/tool-kit): Entrepreneur resources, pitch guides, and Michigan venture capital connections toolkit

## Educational Content & Insights

- [Compare and Contrast Accelerator Programs](https://newenterpriseforum.org/news/compare-and-contrast-accelerator-programs-explore-2): Comparative analysis of startup accelerator programs and selection criteria
- [Co-Founder Matchmaking](https://newenterpriseforum.org/news/co-founder-matchmaking-how-to-make-the-marriage-2): Panel discussion on co-founder selection and founder partnership strategies
- [From Representation to Empowerment](https://newenterpriseforum.org/news/from-representation-to-empowerment-cultivating-2): Panel discussion on diversity, inclusion, and inclusive leadership in startups
